requirement: WO sidebar separates its four views and their addresses while navigation guards retain history

oracle.invariant: Four WO links belong to one Website Opportunities sidebar group, separate from Invitations. Research and legacy Dubai anchors resolve to Research; Places and Settings keep their own addresses. Cancelled navigation and history traversal preserve the current editor; accepted navigation changes its route. All selected tests pass without skip.
